# Choosing components

Start with the user task, then choose the container and state. Component names remain API names; you do not need to learn the source tree first.

## Find a component

Search [all components](/en/components/) by name, task, or interaction, then filter by category and platform. The sidebar uses the same component specification. Reset filters to recover from an empty result.

## General components

| Task | Category | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Structure and navigation | Layout, Navigation | Screen, AppLayout, ScreenHeader, SearchBar |
| Input and selection | Form | Input, Select, DatePicker; FileUpload lives in Media & uploads |
| Display information | Data Display | Avatar, Tag, DescriptionList, DataTable |
| Feedback and recovery | Feedback | EmptyState, StatusBanner, ProgressBar |
| Temporary tasks | Overlays | Modal, Drawer, BottomSheet, FormSheet |

## IM and business interfaces

| Task | Category | Guidance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browse or manage conversations | Conversation | Lists, details, forwarding, and conversation actions |
| Compose the chat surface | Message | Lists, bubbles, status, receipts, and pins |
| Render one message | Message content | Text, image, voice, file, and other content bodies |
| Edit outgoing content | Composer | Composer, recording, emoji, and member selection |
| Send or inspect a packet | Red packets | [Compose, card, open, and details](/en/red-packet/) form one journey |
| Wallet and sensitive confirmation | Accounts & verification | AccountView, PaymentConfirmation, DocumentCapture |
| Host optional capabilities | Plugin interfaces | PluginPage, PluginForm, CapabilityConsent |
| Social relationships and personal content | Contacts, Groups, Profile, Moments | Choose details, settings, or content editing for the task |

## Components, patterns, and App Kit

Use General UI for a control, IM UI for a domain-specific task, [Patterns](/en/patterns/) for cooperating conversation, timeline, and composer panes, and [App Kit](/en/app-kit/) for complete app assembly. Do not import an entire application to reuse a button.

## Integration order

Inspect the preview and states, then usage, API, and platform differences. Check keyboard, drawers, and content widths on desktop; check 320px, long copy, touch targets, and safe areas on mobile. Services, permissions, payment, and persistence remain host-owned.
